name: Inuhime Kannashi
source:
Sakuragi Utaha, a sheltered girl from a wealthy family, is forced into the adult video industry after a family tragedy. Determined holding herself together despite her despair, she approaches filming with resolve—but something about the studio feels unsettlingly... off.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ041728.html/]dlsite[/url]]
